name: Medicine (Neuroscience Specializations), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Medicine — Doctoral Program in Medicine

deadline.value: AY2027 Doctoral Program in Medicine applications closed July 14, 2026 (July 3-14, 2026); AY2028 dates have not yet been published.

gre_subject.value: The Graduate School of Medicine Doctoral Program in Medicine Application Guide does not state any GRE Subject Test requirement.

toefl_min.value: Expected baseline English proficiency at enrollment is TOEFL iBT new score 3.5 (formerly 60; Institution Code 8426); applicants below this level may still apply but risk being judged lacking research English ability.
toefl_min.quote: As a basic expectation at the time of enrollment, applicants are expected to demonstrate English proficiency equivalent to TOEFL iBT new score 3.5 (formerly 60).

english_waiver.value: TOEFL exemptions are strictly limited to applicants who completed all 18 years of primary, secondary, and tertiary education ending in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, or veterinary medicine in a country whose primary language of instruction is English (non-medical Indian STEM degrees are not eligible).
english_waiver.quote: the applicant who have completed or are expected to complete an 18-year school education (primary, secondary, and tertiary education) in which the final field of study is medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, or veterinary medicine in a country in which the primary language of instruction is English.

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact their prospective faculty member before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must contact faculty member before applying.

funding.value: Competitive funding via MEXT Scholarships, the University of Tokyo Fellowship, MEXT Honors Scholarship, JSPS DC fellowships, and private foundation scholarships.
funding.quote: A variety of scholarships are available for students who wish to study in Japan. Although many of them are provided by external entities, there are some scholarships awarded directly by the University of Tokyo.

entry_route.value: Requires an 18-year/5-year degree in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, or veterinary medicine, OR a Master's degree (with individual pre-application eligibility review for foreign Master's holders) or >= 2 years of post-bachelor's research.
entry_route.quote: This clause pertains to persons on whom a Master's degree has been conferred by a foreign university; note that, before applying for admission, applicants must undergo an individual eligibility review

notes: 4-year Ph.D. in Medicine offering Neuropathology, Neurochemistry, Neurobiology, Developmental Neuroscience, Cognitive Neuroscience, Systems Medical Neuroscience, and Sensory Motor Neuroscience. Non-Japanese applicants who did not graduate from a Japanese university must also submit a Certificate of Japanese Language Ability.
